Alpha 1.6.4 is now available.  This update adds workshop editor objects.  Workshop editor objects are custom collections of shapes and/or objects that can be used in any map...  So the next time you're making a level you will not only have access to objects made by the developers but custom editor objects made by the community.  This update also adds preview images for each editor object, updates all objects to spawn flush with the ground surface (not halfway into it), and updates the level editor selection outline among other changes.
